name: Staked USDai
oneLiner: sUSDai is USD.AI's staked wrapper of USDai; share price accrues yield from a PYUSD liquid sleeve and GPU-backed AI-compute loans, with a 30-day queued exit.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: sUSDai resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

collateral: Yield-bearing USD.AI position backed by a mixed reserve stack that currently pairs a large PYUSD liquid sleeve with GPU-backed infrastructure loans financing AI compute; current issuer materials describe value-warranty coverage on new GPU loans
pegMechanism: Stake USDai to receive sUSDai; the token appreciates versus USDai as yield accrues, while unstaking enters the protocol's queued withdrawal flow with fixed 30-day processing windows and a limited instant-liquidity buffer

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USD.AI lists sUSDai OAdapter contracts on Arbitrum and states USDai and sUSDai are available as LayerZero OFTs on other EVM chains. The staked wrapper therefore inherits a third-party OFT route and is scored as external-lock-mint.

mintAuthority.summary: sUSDai (EIP-1967 upgradeable proxy) upgrade path secured by 48-hour TimelockController owned by a 3-of-3 Safe multisig (0x783b08...). Shares minted only by USDai deposit — no privileged mint. Wrapper upgrade path confirmed as timelock-gated multisig.

ProxyAdmin owner() = 0x0eea1ee08611ff4a4e83bfe3916712751995639b (TimelockController, minDelay = 172800 s = 48 h, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE confirmed). Timelock creation events at block 24993318: PROPOSER_ROLE, CANCELLER_ROLE, EXECUTOR_ROLE granted to Safe 0x783b08aa21de056717173f72e04be0e91328a07b; EXECUTOR_ROLE also granted to SafeProxy 0x5f0bc72fb5952b2f3f2e11404398ed507b25841f (same 3 owners, threshold 3). Safe getOwners() = [0xe982b3f..., 0x986868c..., 0xd1affe2...], getThreshold() = 3. sUSDai shares minted only by USDai deposit.

controls.label: Inherited USDai permissioned mint authority
controls.evidence: Underlying USDai is minted 1:1 by KYC'ed institutions via the USDai deposit() contract under role-based access (STRATEGY_ADMIN_ROLE multisig, BRIDGE_ADMIN_ROLE). sUSDai inherits this concentrated-admin posture from the parent.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295219: sUSDai proxy upgrade path = ProxyAdmin → 48-hour TimelockController → 3-of-3 Safe. No privileged mint on the wrapper; shares minted only by USDai deposit. Exit-queue parameters controlled by same Safe via Timelock (cannot mint base USDai). Parent USDai mint path tracked separately.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: sUSDai is the GPU-financing and private-credit vault layer and intentionally departs from the liquid USDai reserve receipt.
